Immutable IUniswapV2Pair reference for the ETH/REB pool queried for cumulative prices and reserves
Immutable IUniswapV2Pair reference for the USDC/ETH pool queried for cumulative prices and reserves
constructor: reads initial cumulative prices and block timestamps from both hardcoded Uniswap pairs
internal view getRebEthRate(): computes average REB/ETH price from cumulative price deltas over elapsed time
internal view getUsdcEthRate(): computes average USDC/ETH price from cumulative price deltas over elapsed time
external update(): permissionless refresh of stored cumulative snapshots and lastAnswer, guarded only by MIN_PERIOD
external view getData(): returns lastAnswer while inside UPDATE_LAG, otherwise recomputes the price from current cumulative values
block.timestamp: miner/validator-influenced value used for the update interval, freshness window and price averaging
Unchecked subtraction (price1Cumulative - ethRebPrice1CumulativeLast) in getRebEthRate; underflow wraps in Solidity 0.6
Unchecked subtraction (_blockTimestamp - ethRebBlockTimestampLast) used as divisor in getRebEthRate; zero/underflow risk
Unchecked subtraction (price0Cumulative - usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast) in getUsdcEthRate; underflow wraps in Solidity 0.6
Unchecked subtraction (_blockTimestamp - usdcEthBlockTimestampLast) used as divisor in getUsdcEthRate; zero/underflow risk
Unchecked (rebEthAverage * 1e18) / usdcEthAverage in update(); overflow and division-by-zero risk with truncated average
Unchecked (rebEthAverage * 1e18) / usdcEthAverage in getData(); overflow and division-by-zero risk on attacker-manipulable reserves
local timeStamp in update(): copy of block.timestamp
local timeElapsed in update(): unchecked difference between block.timestamp and lastUpdateTimestamp
local rebEthAverage in update(): REB/ETH average returned by getRebEthRate()
local usdcEthAverage in update(): USDC/ETH average returned by getUsdcEthRate()
local answer in getData(): final computed REB/USD price returned to caller
local rebEthAverage in getData(): REB/ETH average returned by getRebEthRate()
local usdcEthAverage in getData(): USDC/ETH average returned by getUsdcEthRate()
